data.description: 【令 · 江上画舫夜航】月夜下的江面浮光跃金，一艘描金画舫缓缓行于水上。令倚在舫头凭栏，素白羽衣的衣摆浸着水光，提着一只酒盏遥遥对月。江风送来她低低的吟诵——「醉后不知天在水，满船清梦压星河。」
data.lighting: moonlit river reflections, golden lantern bokeh from the cabin, silver water ripples
data.promptProse: At the gilt pleasure boat’s bow, Ling leans on the carved railing and raises a wine cup toward the moon while quietly reciting verse. Preserve the white feathered robe and the wide medium framing. The bow rail curves across the near edge, deck planks lead back toward the cabin, and the river opens beyond the hull in the direction of travel. Golden light from the cabin lanterns runs along the carved rail and catches the lifted sleeve folds. Broken moon reflections stretch across the moving water below; a cool reflected edge touches the robe hem while the rail leaves a soft shadow on the deck.
data.title: 令 · 江上画舫夜航
